subclassFeature.name: The King of Heroes
entries: You have inherited the power of the King of Heroes, whose treasury contains the prototypes of countless legendary treasures. Wealth bends toward you, ancient relics answer your call, and the world itself seems to remember that all treasures were once meant to belong to their king.

subclassFeature.name: Gate of Babylon
entries: Gate of Babylon It grants him access to all of the world's treasures that he collected during his life, which include prototypes of other heroes' Noble Phantasms, and he can launch them as the strongest arrows towards his opponents.

As an action, you can open the Gate of Babylon and launch a weapon from your treasury at a creature you can see within 120 feet. Roll on the Treasury of Babylon Table to determine the weapon and its damage. Make a ranged weapon attack using your Wisdom modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity for both the attack and damage rolls. This attack counts as both a ranged weapon attack and a thrown weapon attack.

entries.caption: Treasury of Babylon
rows: After the attack, Bab-ilu falls to the ground in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target. Until you retrieve Bab-ilu, you cannot use Gate of Babylon or Key of the King's Law, Bab-ilu. You can retrieve Bab-ilu by moving to its space and picking it up. Alternatively, Bab-ilu returns to you when you finish a Long Rest.
A creature damaged by Dáinsleif cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn, regardless of the source of the healing.
You have Expertise with this weapon, allowing you to add your Proficiency Bonus twice to the attack roll made with it. This attack ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
Each creature in a 15-foot-wide line extending from you to the target takes the weapon's damage if the attack roll equals or exceeds its AC.
This attack is always a critical hit.
The Harpe ignores all Resistance. When you deal damage to a creature with this weapon, its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage dealt
The Vajra ignores all Resistance. When you hit a creature with this weapon, each creature within 15 feet of the target takes an additional 2d6 Thunder damage.

The Gram ignores all Resistance. Any Immunity to its damage is treated as Resistance instead. When you hit a creature with this weapon, the attack deals an additional 3d8 Radiant damage. If the creature is a Dragon, all damage dealt by this weapon is doubled.

The Merodach ignores all Resistance. Any Immunity to its damage is treated as Resistance instead. When you hit a creature with this weapon, the attack deals maximum damage. If the target is wearing or wielding a magic item, the damage dealt by this weapon is doubled.

The Enkidu, Chains of Heaven ignores all Resistance and Immunity to the damage it deals. This attack automatically hits, the target is Restrained by the chains. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Strength saving throw against your save DC, ending the effect on a success. If the target is a Celestial, all damage dealt by this weapon is doubled.

The Ea, Sword of Rupture ignores all Resistance and Immunity to the damage it deals. This attack automatically hits. Each creature in a 25-foot-wide line between you and the target takes the weapon's damage. As the attack travels, it dispels all spells and magical effects within the line, ending them immediately regardless of the spell's level or the effect's source. Objects and structures that are targeted by this weapon or are within the line take double damage from it.

The Holy Grail can fulfill a wish as though you had cast the {@spell Wish} spell. You suffer none of the spell's risks or drawbacks. You do not lose the ability to cast {@spell Wish} again, and you suffer no exhaustion or other adverse effects from making the wish.

subclassFeature.name: Key of the King's Law, Bab-ilu
entries: A golden key-shaped sword that connects to the treasury. Only he is able to utilize Bab-ilu, Because lacking the wisdom to understand its constantly changing shape will render it unable to open the treasury.
The key can unlock any door, container, or other object that possesses a lock, regardless of its complexity or magical nature. It cannot open objects that have no lock.

subclassFeature.name: Enkidu : Chains of Heaven
entries: Your Hunter's Mark manifests as the divine Chains of Heaven. When you mark a creature with your Hunter's Mark, golden chains bind the creature for the duration of the spell.

items: The creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
The creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.
The creature can't take actions or reactions.
At the start of each of its turns, the creature can make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC, ending the effect on a success.
The creature cannot use Legendary Resistance to succeed on this saving throw.

entries: The chains are especially powerful against divine beings. If the marked creature is a Celestial, it has disadvantage on the Strength saving throw against the Chains of Heaven.
If the marked creature is a Celestial, any attack that hits it is a critical hit.

subclassFeature.name: Wedge of Heaven
entries: You have reached the height of the King's authority, gaining the following abilities:

entries.name: Divinity
entries: Your attacks can pierce supernatural defenses. Your attacks ignore all Resistance. Any Immunity to the damage dealt by your attacks is treated as Resistance instead.

entries.name: Golden Rule
entries: You can sense the location of precious objects, such as magic items, coins, and gems, within 120 feet of you, even if they are hidden or concealed.
You have advantage on any ability check or other roll made to locate, identify, appraise, acquire, or otherwise interact with precious objects.

entries.name: The One Who Saw It All
entries: Your understanding of the world transcends ordinary limits. You add your Wisdom modifier to your Charisma modifier when determining your total Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Treasury of Babylon
entries: You can store any precious object, such as a magic item, coins, or gems, within your Gate of Babylon. Objects stored within the Gate are preserved and do not age, decay, or deteriorate.
You can also create a magic item by converting gold into the item. The amount of gold required is equal to the item's value.

subclassFeature.name: Enuma Elish
entries: As an action, you use the Ea, Sword of Rupture to unleash Enuma Elish. Roll a number of {@dice d100} equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die). The total is the amount of Force damage dealt by the attack.
The attack automatically hits. Each creature in a 25-foot-wide and 120-foot-long line extending from you in a direction of your choice takes Force damage equal to the total.
As the attack travels, it dispels all spells and magical effects within the line, ending them immediately regardless of the spell's level or the effect's source.
The Ea ignores all Resistance and Immunity to the damage it deals.
Objects and structures that are targeted by this attack or are within the line take double damage from it.

subclassFeature.name: Sha Naqba Imuru
entries: You possess the wisdom of the King who saw the beginning of all things. You gain truesight out to a range of 120 feet.
You permanently gain the benefits of the {@spell Foresight} spell. This is not a spell effect, does not require concentration, cannot be dispelled, and lasts indefinitely.

subclassFeature.name: The Black Swordsman
entries: "Two blades. One will. No enemy beyond your reach."

The Black Swordsman walks a path where offense and defense become a single, seamless motion. Wielding two swords simultaneously, they overwhelm their opponents through relentless speed, precision, and flowing swordplay.

Each blade moves independently, yet both strike as one. From Cross Block, which uses both swords to intercept incoming attacks, to Double Circular, which closes the distance in a blur of steel, and the devastating Starburst Stream, which unleashes a storm of strikes in rapid succession.

Those who master the highest reaches of this art gain access to The Eclipse, the ultimate Dual Blades Sword Skill. A technique that transforms combat into a deadly one-on-one duel, where neither combatant can turn away until one of them can no longer fight.

subclassFeature.name: Dual Blades
entries: You can wield two one-handed swords simultaneously, even if they do not have the Light property. For this feature, longswords, rapiers, and scimitars are considered swords.

While wielding two swords, when you make a melee weapon attack with one of those swords, you can immediately make one additional melee weapon attack with the other sword against the same target. This additional attack requires no action or bonus action.
Each attack is resolved separately and uses the weapon used for that attack, including its damage dice, magical properties, additional damage, and other effects.
Effects that apply to the first attack are not duplicated by the additional attack. Effects granted by the second weapon apply normally to the additional attack.

subclassFeature.name: Cross Block
entries: When you are hit by an attack that uses an attack roll while you are wielding two swords, you can cross your swords to block the attack. The attack hits you as normal, but you take 0 damage from that attack.
You can use this feature a number of times per round equal to half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down). You regain all expended uses at the start of your next turn.
This feature requires no action, bonus action, or reaction.

subclassFeature.name: Double Circular
entries: As a Bonus Action, you can move in a straight line up to twice your walking speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
When you stop moving, you can make two melee weapon attacks, one with each sword you are wielding. Each attack is resolved separately.
You can make the two attacks against the same creature or different creatures.

subclassFeature.name: Starburst Stream
entries: As an Action, you unleash Starburst Stream, making 16 melee weapon attacks in rapid succession, alternating between the two swords you are wielding, beginning with either sword.
Each attack is resolved separately and uses the weapon used for that attack, including its damage dice, magical properties, additional damage, and other effects.

subclassFeature.name: The Eclipse
entries: As an Action, you choose one creature you can see within the range of your movement and rush toward it. You move to a space within your melee weapon's reach of the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
You then begin a deadly duel with the target. You make two melee weapon attacks against the target, one with each sword you are wielding. The target then makes one attack against you.
You and the target continue alternating turns in this manner, with you making two attacks, followed by the target making one attack, until either you or the target is reduced to 0 hit points.

While this duel is active, you and the target cannot use any action, bonus action, reaction, movement, or feature other than the attacks granted by The Eclipse. Neither combatant can willingly move away from the other or target another creature.
The duel ends immediately when either combatant is reduced to 0 hit points.

subclassFeature.name: Tenjō Tenge Yuiga Dokuson
entries: Your are a special grade jujutsu sorcerer and widely recognized as the strongest in the world. the first person to inherit both the Limitless and the Six Eyes in many hundred years.

subclassFeature.name: Mukagen
entries: Mukagen is the fundamental application of the Limitless, granting you near-absolute control over space through the manipulation of cursed energy at an atomic level. By manipulating the space between yourself and the world around you, you can produce a variety of techniques and effects that defy conventional understanding.
You learn Eldritch Blast. It does not count against your number of Cantrips known.
Your immense cursed energy and unparalleled control allow you to cast Eldritch Blast as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Jutsushiki Junten
entries: Jutsushiki Junten is the application of your Cursed Technique through the forward flow of cursed energy, allowing you to manipulate its natural properties and produce powerful spatial effects

entries.name: Jutsushiki Junten・Ao
entries: When you cast Eldritch Blast using a clockwise rotation, the blast becomes Blue. It deals an additional 1d6 force damage

When the Jutsushiki Junten・Ao hits a creature, it explodes into a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Any creature within the sphere whose AC is less than or equal to your Eldritch Blast attack roll is drawn toward the center of the sphere and takes the Eldritch Blast's damage.

entries.name: Jutsushiki Hanten・Aka
entries: When you cast Eldritch Blast using a counterclockwise rotation, the blast becomes Red. It deals an additional 1d12 force damage
When the Jutsushiki Hanten・Aka hits a creature, The target is pushed up to 30 feet away from you.

subclassFeature.name: Kokusen
entries: Kokusen is a phenomenon created by the precise application of cursed energy, causing a spatial distortion that amplifies the destructive power of your strike. When you score a critical hit, you deal double the damage.

subclassFeature.name: Mugen
entries: Mugen is the neutral form of the Limitless, manipulating the space between you and anything that approaches. Rather than stopping an attack, it divides the remaining distance into an infinite series, causing anything that approaches you to slow down endlessly before making contact.

As a Bonus Action, you can activate Mugen for 1 minute. While Mugen is active, attack rolls made against you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects. Once you activate Mugen, you cannot do so again until you finish a Short Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Spatial Manipulation
entries: You can manipulate the space around you, allowing you to teleport instead of walking. You can teleport to any unoccupied space you can see within a distance equal to your walking speed.
This movement ignores all terrain, obstacles, creatures, elevation, and other physical barriers. You do not need a clear path between your current location and your destination.
You can teleport to a point in the air and remain suspended there, allowing you to move freely through the air without falling.

subclassFeature.name: Rikugan
entries: Your Six Eyes grant you unparalleled perception and control over cursed energy, granting you the following benefits:
• You gain Truesight out to a range of 120 feet. Within this range, you can perceive the true nature of creatures, objects, and magical effects.
• You have Advantage on Arcana checks.
While Mugen is active, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on spell attack rolls.
• Your Spell Save DC increases by an amount equal to your class level divided by 5, rounded down.
• Whenever you cast Eldritch Blast, you can create one additional beam, and your Eldritch Blast attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

subclassFeature.name: Shutsuryoku Saidai
entries: You can amplify your Cursed Techniques to their maximum output, increasing their destructive power beyond their normal limits. You can use this feature a number of times equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short Rest.

entries.name: Jutsushiki Junten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Ao
entries: When you use Jutsushiki Junten・Ao, you can amplify Blue to its maximum output. The damage of the technique is calculated as (your Eldritch Blast damage + other bonuses) × the number of Eldritch Blast beams you can create + your class level.

When the Jutsushiki Junten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Ao hits a creature, it explodes into a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Any creature within the sphere whose AC is less than or equal to your attack roll is drawn toward the center of the sphere and takes the Jutsushiki Junten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Ao damage.

entries.name: Jutsushiki Hanten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Aka
entries: When you use Jutsushiki Hanten・Aka, you can amplify Red to its maximum output. The damage of the technique is calculated as ((your Eldritch Blast damage + other bonuses) × (the number of Eldritch Blast beams you can create + half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down)) + your class level.
When the Jutsushiki Hanten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Aka, the target is pushed up to 60 feet away from you.

subclassFeature.name: Kyoshiki・Murasaki
entries: You combine Jutsushiki Junten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Ao and Jutsushiki Hanten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Aka to create Hollow Purple, a destructive technique formed from the convergence of attraction and repulsion.

This technique requires 2 uses of Shutsuryoku Saidai. You use your Action to activate Jutsushiki Junten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Ao and your Bonus Action to activate Jutsushiki Hanten Shutsuryoku Saidai・Aka. Once both techniques have been activated, they converge to create Kyoshiki・Murasaki.
The damage of the technique is calculated as (((your Eldritch Blast damage + 1d20 + other bonuses) × (the number of Eldritch Blast beams you can create + your Proficiency Bonus)) + your class level).

When you use Kyoshiki・Murasaki, you release a devastating beam in a straight line that is 15 feet wide and 100 feet long. Any creature within the beam whose AC is less than or equal to your attack roll takes the Kyoshiki・Murasaki damage.

subclassFeature.name: Hanten Jutsushiki
entries: Hanten Jutsushiki is the reversal of your Cursed Energy, converting its destructive nature into restorative power. As long as your body remains intact, you can continuously restore yourself.
At the start of your turn, you regain Hit Points equal to your class level + your Charisma modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Muryōkūsho
entries: Muryōkūsho is your Domain Expansion, creating a metaphysical space that overwhelms those trapped within it with an endless stream of information and sensory stimuli.
As an Action, you can expand your Domain in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on yourself. The Domain lasts for 1 minute and requires Concentration, as if concentrating on a spell.
When a creature of your choice enters the Domain for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it becomes overwhelmed by the infinite flow of information.
The creature is subjected to a special condition called Overwhelmed. While Overwhelmed, the creature gains the following effects:
• The creature can't take Actions or Reactions.
• The creature can't move or speak.
• The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
• Attack Rolls against the creature have Advantage.
• Any Attack that hits the creature is a Critical Hit.
At the end of each of its turns, an Overwhelmed creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, ending the condition on itself on a successful save.
You and friendly creatures you are physically touching are immune to the effects of your Muryōkūsho.
Once you use Muryōkūsho, you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Shining Diamond Domain
entries: Clerics who follow the Shining Diamond Domain are blessed with the divine power of restoration and reconstruction. Their sacred power manifests as a radiant guardian known as the Shining Diamond, a supernatural force capable of mending what has been broken and restoring what has been damaged.

Unlike other divine domains that focus primarily on destruction or protection, the Shining Diamond Domain teaches that nothing should be discarded simply because it has been broken. Through divine will, a shattered object can be made whole, a wounded body can be restored, and even severe damage can be reversed.

Clerics of this domain are often found among healers, guardians, artisans, and those who protect the people around them. Their power is strongest when used to preserve and restore others, turning destruction into something whole once more.
A Shining Diamond cleric does not merely heal wounds. They command the power to restore what was lost, repair what was broken, and protect what remains.

subclassFeature.name: Shining Diamond Domain Spells
entries: You gain domain spells at the cleric levels listed in the Shining Diamond Domain Spells table. See the Divine Domain class feature for how domain spells work.

entries.caption: Shining Diamond Domain Spells
rows: {@spell cure wounds}, {@spell shield}, {@spell prayer of healing}, {@spell lesser restoration}

subclassFeature.name: Stand: Crazy Diamond
entries: You can manifest a supernatural guardian known as Crazy Diamond. Crazy Diamond is manifested without requiring an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. It appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you and remains manifested until you dismiss it, become Incapacitated, or die.
Crazy Diamond cannot move more than 10 feet away from you. If it would ever be more than 10 feet away from you, it immediately moves to the nearest unoccupied space within 10 feet of you.

Crazy Diamond shares your senses, allowing it to see and hear what you see and hear. It also shares your Hit Points and Armor Class with you. Any damage dealt to Crazy Diamond is instead dealt to you.
Crazy Diamond is immune to all Conditions and cannot be affected by effects that would impose a Condition upon it.

When you take the Attack action, Crazy Diamond can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} in place of one of your attacks. You can also make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} with Crazy Diamond when an effect allows you to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb}.

Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} uses your Wisdom modifier for its attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity. Its reach is 5 feet, and it deals 1d10 Force damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a hit.

Your Crazy Diamond {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} benefit from your Divine Strike feature. When you gain additional benefits from Divine Strike, those benefits also apply to Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb}.
Crazy Diamond uses your proficiency bonus and other relevant modifiers when making attack rolls and saving throws.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity: Diamond is Unbreakable
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to restore a creature or object to a previous state.

As an action, you can strike one other creature or one object within 10 feet of you with your Crazy Diamond power, restoring it to a state it was in at some point within the last 1 minute. The target doesn't travel through time; instead, its physical condition and state are restored to the condition it had at the chosen point in time.

When you restore a creature, its Hit Points, Conditions, physical injuries, and other changes to its body are restored to how they were at the chosen point in time. Any damage, poison, disease, or other effects that were not present at that point are removed. Likewise, wounds or other harmful effects that existed at the chosen point remain.

If the target died within the last 1 minute, you can restore it to a point before its death, regardless of how it died. No spell, magical effect, curse, condition, damage, or other cause of death can prevent this restoration, provided the target died within the last 1 minute. The creature returns to life with the Hit Points, Conditions, and physical state it had at that point. This restoration doesn't require material components.

When you restore an object, its physical form is restored to the state it had at the chosen point in time. Broken, damaged, or destroyed parts can be restored, provided the object existed in that state within the last 1 minute.
You cannot restore a creature or object to a state that it never possessed. The restoration only reverses changes that occurred within the last 1 minute.

subclassFeature.name: DORA!
entries: Whenever you use Crazy Diamond to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it can make two {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} instead of one.

subclassFeature.name: Crazy Diamond: Full Power
entries: Your bond with Crazy Diamond deepens, allowing its destructive power and miraculous restoration to reach a new level.

entries.name: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Full Power
entries: The restoration of your Diamond Is Unbreakable becomes more powerful.
When you use your Channel Divinity: Diamond Is Unbreakable, you can now restore the target to a state it was in at any point within the last 10 minutes.

When the Jutsushiki Junten・Ao hits a creature, it explodes into a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Any creature within the sphere whose AC is less than or equal to your Eldritch Blast attack roll is drawn toward the center of the sphere and takes the Eldritch Blast's damage.

entries.name: Stand Barrage
entries: Crazy Diamond releases its true power. The Stand's presence becomes more overwhelming, its fists strike with greater force, and its ability to restore what has been broken reaches a new level of perfection.
You gain the following benefits:
• You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to have Crazy Diamond make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.
• The damage die for Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} becomes a d12 instead of a d10.
• Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

subclassFeature.name: DORARARA!
entries: Whenever you use Crazy Diamond to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it can make three {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} instead of one.

subclassFeature.name: Crazy Diamond: Limite Break
entries: Crazy Diamond shatters the limits that once restrained its power. Its fists carry overwhelming destructive force, while its ability to restore the broken reaches a level beyond ordinary restoration. At this stage, Crazy Diamond no longer merely repairs what was damaged—it defies destruction itself, forcibly returning what was lost to the state it once held.

entries.name: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Limite Break
entries: The restoration of your Diamond Is Unbreakable reaches its ultimate potential.
When you use your Channel Divinity: Diamond Is Unbreakable, you can now restore the target to a state it was in at any point within the last 24 hours.

entries.name: Crazy Beatdown
entries: Crazy Diamond breaks through its limits and releases its ultimate power. Its fists become devastatingly powerful, while its supernatural ability to restore what has been broken reaches its absolute peak. At this level, even destruction that would normally be considered irreversible can be undone.
You gain the following benefits:
• Whenever you use Crazy Diamond to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it can make four {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} instead of one.
• The damage die for Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} increases by one additional die, becoming 2d12 instead of 1d12.
• Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19 or 20.
• A Critical Hit with Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} allows it to make one additional {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} immediately after the attack.

• A Critical Hit with Crazy Diamond's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} forcibly restores and reassembles parts of the target's body or equipment in an unstable state, reducing the target's Armor Class by 2 for 1 minute. This effect stacks, and each additional Critical Hit against the target resets the duration to 1 minute.

subclassFeature.name: The Full Blood Saiyan
entries: {@i 1st-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Born with the complete blood of the Saiyan race, you possess a natural affinity for battle and an extraordinary capacity to surpass your own limits. Through relentless training and the heat of combat, you awaken increasingly powerful transformations, mastering the path from Super Saiyan to God power and beyond.

subclassFeature.name: Pure Saiyan Blood
entries: {@i 1st-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}
Your pure Saiyan blood grants you exceptional physical potential. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 2 for each Saiyan level you have.
In addition, your Ability Scores increase as your Saiyan body develops. At 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th level, increase one Ability Score of your choice by 1.

subclassFeature.name: Pseudo Super Saiyan
entries: {@i 1st-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}
When a Saiyan is on the brink of death, they may briefly manifest the power of a Full Blood Saiyan, resulting in this form. It is inaccessible at will.

When you are pushed to the brink of death, the dormant power of the Full Blood Saiyan awakens within you. When you are reduced to 25% of your Hit Point maximum or less, you can awaken this power, causing your aura to flare with golden energy. The transformation lasts for 1 minute. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by one step.
• Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
• You have Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Once the transformation ends, you cannot awaken this power again until you finish a Long Rest.
After you unlock Super Saiyan 1, this feature is inactive.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan
entries: {@i 3rd-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Ancient legends tell of a Saiyan warrior who could transcend the limits of their mortal body and awaken a power far beyond that of an ordinary Saiyan. When pushed beyond their limits by overwhelming adversity, a Saiyan may awaken this power, causing their hair to turn golden and their aura to blaze with radiant energy.
To awaken Super Saiyan, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 14 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 100 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, a creature you consider an ally must die within your line of sight.

After awaken Super Saiyan you can expend 2 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by one die.
• Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to acid, bludgeoning, piercing, poison, and slashing damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Ki Art I
entries: {@i 3rd-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}
You learn to refine and transform your Ki into specialized forms, allowing you to create highly concentrated energy techniques with greater power, range, and precision.

items.name: Final Explosion
entries: You release an enormous amount of Ki from your entire body at once, creating a devastating explosion centered on yourself.

When you are Bloodied and a hostile creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack or begins casting a spell, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend all your remaining Ki Points and unleash them in a massive explosion centered on yourself. The explosion occurs before the triggering attack or spell is resolved.

You and each other creature within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
If you succeed on your saving throw against Final Explosion, you are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead of taking damage from the explosion.

items.name: Kamehameha
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 5 Ki Points to concentrate your Ki into a single point. and unleash a powerful, streaming beam of energy. The wave travels up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide.

Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended, multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Charged Kamehameha.} When you use Kamehameha, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy this turn.

On your next turn, you must use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to release the charged Kamehameha. When released, the streaming beam of energy travels up to 60 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 2 higher when calculating the attack's damage.

While charging Kamehameha, you must maintain Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. If you don't release the charged Kamehameha on your next turn or lose Concentration before releasing it, the gathered energy dissipates and the Ki Points expended are lost.

items.name: Galick Gun
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 5 Ki Points to fire a concentrated beam of purple Ki at one creature within 60 feet of you.

Make a ranged attack roll using your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} attack bonus. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended +1. A critical hit occurs on a roll of 19 or 20.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan 2
entries: {@i 6th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

You are a Saiyan who has pushed the power of the Super Saiyan beyond its limits, awakening a form of even greater ferocity and destructive power. Your golden aura erupts with crackling lightning, your golden hair rises sharply, and your power intensifies to a terrifying degree.
To awaken Super Saiyan 2, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 16 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 250 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you and at least two of your allies must become Bloodied or be reduced to 0 hit points.
You can expend 4 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan 2 without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by two die.
• Your Speed increases by 20 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to acid, bludgeoning, cold, lightning, piercing, poison, slashing,and thunder damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Ki Art II
entries: {@i 3rd-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}
You learn to refine and transform your Ki into specialized forms, allowing you to create highly concentrated energy techniques with greater power, range, and precision.

items.name: Spirit Bomb
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 10 Ki Points to gather huge amounts of energy from all chosen surrounding life forms and inanimate objects to conduct that energy into a massive sphere of astounding destructive power before throwing it at a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself.
The Spirit Bomb detonates at that point in a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the sphere takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended

{@b Charged Spirit Bomb.} When you use Spirit Bomb, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. While you are charging the Spirit Bomb, a creature that can perceive you can use its {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to willingly lend its power to the Spirit Bomb.

On your next turn, you must use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to release the charged Spirit Bomb. When released, the Spirit Bomb detonates at the chosen point in a 30-foot-radius sphere. For each creature that lends its power to the Spirit Bomb, the sphere's radius increases by 5 feet, and the damage increases by an amount equal to your Ki Damage.

While charging Spirit Bomb, you must maintain Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. If you don't release the charged Final Flash on your next turn or lose Concentration before releasing it, the gathered energy dissipates and the Ki Points expended are lost.

items.name: Big Bang Attack
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 10 Ki Points to condense your Ki into a blue energy sphere before launching it at one creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself.

Make a ranged attack roll using your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} attack bonus. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended +2. A critical hit occurs on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

When Big Bang Attack hits a creature, it explodes into a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Each creature within the sphere whose AC is less than or equal to your attack roll takes Big Bang Attack damage.

items.name: Super Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery of the Kamehameha allows you to channel far greater amounts of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 10 Ki Points when using Kamehameha. and its normal range increases to 40 feet.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 80 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 3 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 2 higher.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan 3
entries: {@i 10th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Super Saiyan 3 greatly increases a Saiyan's power and Ki utilization, causing their golden hair to grow enormously long and their eyebrows to vanish completely. The transformation consumes far more Ki than Super Saiyan 2, placing immense strain on the body and causing severe fatigue even after the transformation ends.
To awaken Super Saiyan 3, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan 2.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 18 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you and at least two of your allies must each be reduced to 0 hit points. You must then regain at least 1 hit point and continue participating in the encounter.
You can expend 8 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan 3 without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by three die.
• Your Speed increases by 30 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to acid, bludgeoning, cold, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, radiant, slashing,and thunder damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Ki Art III
entries: {@i 10th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

You reach the pinnacle of Ki manipulation, gaining the ability to freely transform and shape your Ki into virtually any form your mastery can conceive, unleashing techniques that push the limits of Ki itself.

items.name: Dragon Fist
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 15 Ki Points to draw back your clenched fist and charge toward your opponent, channeling an immense surge of Ki into your strike. As your fist connects, the Ki erupts into the form of a massive golden, shining dragon that surges through your enemy with overwhelming force.

Choose one creature you can see within a distance equal to your Speed. You move in a straight line toward the target without expending your movement, then make a melee attack roll against it using your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} attack bonus. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended +3. A critical hit occurs on a roll of 17, 18, 19, or 20.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

items.name: Final Flash
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 15 Ki Points to spread your arms and gather Ki between your palms, forming a sphere of golden energy crackling with electricity. You then thrust your hands forward, unleashing the gathered energy as a massive golden beam whose size and power increase with the amount of Ki channeled into it.

The golden energy travels up to 120 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended, multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

{@b Charged Final Flash.} When you use Final Flash, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy this turn.

On your next turn, you must use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to release the charged Final Flash. When released, the golden energy travels up to 300 feet in a line that is 15 feet wide, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as twice that amount when calculating the attack's damage.

While charging Final Flash, you must maintain Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. If you don't release the charged Final Flash on your next turn or lose Concentration before releasing it, the gathered energy dissipates and the Ki Points expended are lost.

items.name: True Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery of the Kamehameha has reached an extraordinary level, allowing you to channel even greater amounts of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 15 Ki Points when using Kamehameha. its normal range increases to 50 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 100 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 3 higher.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan God
entries: {@i 14th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Super Saiyan God is a legend among legends of the Saiyan warrior race. To awaken this legendary form, the power of good-hearted companions must be gathered and infused into a single Saiyan. Unlike other Super Saiyan transformations, this form causes only subtle changes to the Saiyan's appearance, the most notable being their hair turning a vivid shade of red.
To awaken Super Saiyan God, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan 3.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 20 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 1000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.

{@b Super Saiyan God Ritual.} To awaken Super Saiyan God, every other member of your party must willingly channel their energy into you. At the end of the ritual, each creature that channeled its energy into you gains 1 level of Exhaustion, and you permanently unlock Super Saiyan God.
You can expend 6 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan God without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by three die.
• Your Speed increases by 60 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.

subclassFeature.name: God Ki Art
entries: {@i 14th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Having awakened God Ki, you learn to refine your Ki into divine energy and wield it with extraordinary control and efficiency. God Ki Arts are advanced Ki techniques that can only be used while you have access to God Ki.

items.name: God Shot
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to your Proficiency Bonus to fire concentrated shots of divine Ki. For each Ki Point expended, you fire one God Shot at a creature you can see within 120 feet of you. You can direct the shots at the same target or different targets.
Each shot uses your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} attack bonus for its attack roll and deals Force damage equal to your Ki Damage on a hit.
Each God Shot scores a critical hit on a roll of 15 or higher.
God Shot ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

items.name: God Heat Flash
entries: Your mastery of divine Ki elevates the Final Flash into the God Heat Flash, allowing you to channel vastly greater amounts of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 20 Ki Points when using Final Flash.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

In addition, when you use Charged Final Flash, you no longer need to use your Action on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Final Flash at the start of your next turn without using an Action or Bonus Action.

items.name: Limitbreaker Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery of the Kamehameha has surpassed its limits, allowing you to channel an extraordinary amount of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 20 Ki Points when using Kamehameha. Its normal range increases to 60 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 120 feet, and you no longer need to use your Action on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an Action or Bonus Action.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan Blue
entries: {@i 18th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Super Saiyan Blue is the result of a Super Saiyan harnessing the power of Super Saiyan God and surpassing their limits. In this form, you become both immensely powerful and tranquil, maintaining perfect control and composure even in the midst of battle. This form is nearly identical to the first Super Saiyan form, the only main differences being that the hair and irises change to teal, though while the aura is active they both appear electric blue.
To awaken Super Saiyan Blue, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan God.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 22 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 2500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
You can expend 8 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan Blue without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by four die.
• Your Speed increases by 90 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced God Ki Art
entries: {@i 18th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

Having mastered the fundamentals of God Ki, you learn to wield divine energy with even greater precision, control, and efficiency. Advanced God Ki Arts are highly refined divine techniques that represent the next stage of your mastery over God Ki.

items.name: Final God Explosion
entries: Your mastery of divine Ki elevates Final Explosion into the Final God Explosion, allowing you to unleash your remaining energy with overwhelming destructive force. The explosion's radius increases to 60 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.
If the hostile creature that triggered Final God Explosion fails its saving throw against the explosion, the triggering attack or spell is interrupted and has no effect.
When another creature fails its saving throw against Final God Explosion and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the explosion, its body is completely disintegrated, leaving nothing behind.

items.name: God Final Flash
entries: Your mastery over divine Ki perfects the God Heat Flash into the God Final Flash, granting you absolute control over the immense energy gathered by the technique. You can now expend up to 25 Ki Points when using Final Flash.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.
In addition, Charged Final Flash no longer requires Concentration.

items.name: God Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery over divine Ki elevates the Limitbreaker Kamehameha into the God Kamehameha, granting you absolute control over the immense energy gathered by the technique. You can now expend up to 25 Ki Points when using Kamehameha.  Its normal range increases to 60 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 120 feet, no longer requires Concentration, and you no longer need to use your Action on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an Action or Bonus Action.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Saiyan
entries: {@i 20th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}

You have transcended the limits of mortal power and now stand at the crossroads of two divine paths. Choose the path you will walk: the instinctive mastery of the Angels, leading to Ultra Instinct, or the boundless destructive spirit of the Gods of Destruction, leading to Ultra Ego.
To awaken Ultra Instinct or Ultra Ego, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 30 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 5000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.

{@b Choose the path.} When you first transform using either Ultra Instinct or Ultra Ego, that form becomes your chosen path. This choice is permanent, and you can no longer transform into any other form.

items.name: Ultra Instinct
entries: Ultra Instinct allows your body to act independently of conscious thought, instinctively evading and countering attacks with extraordinary precision. As the battle intensifies, your speed, power, efficiency, and Ki continue to grow, allowing your fighting ability to reach its full potential.
You can expend 10 Ki Points to transform into Ultra Instinct without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• Your attacks always hit and are always critical hits.
• Your Ki Damage increases by five dice.
• Your Speed increases by 120 feet.
• You have Advantage on all saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.
• Other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
• You can take up to three {@variantrule Reactions|XPHB} per round.
• When an attack roll would hit you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to dodge it, causing the attack to miss you instead.
• When you fail a saving throw, you can use your Reaction to succeed instead.

items.name: Ultra Ego
entries: Ultra Ego transforms your Ki into the divine energy of a God of Destruction, allowing your power to grow instinctively without limit as your fighting spirit intensifies.
You can expend 10 Ki Point to transform into a Ultra Ego without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by five die.
• Your Speed increases by 120 feet.
• You have Advantage all saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.
• Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your Strength modifier + your Constitution modifier, to a minimum of 1 damage. and you regain 1 Ki Point
• Whenever you have taken damage 10 times while transformed, your Ki Damage increases by one die.
• When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you immediately make a death saving throw. On a success, you are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead.

• When you take damage from a creature within your reach, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce that damage by an amount equal to your Ki Damage. You can then immediately take one {@variantrule Action|XPHB} against that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Mastered God Ki Art
entries: {@i 20th-level Full Blood Saiyan feature}
Your God Ki has reached its absolute peak, allowing you to wield divine energy through techniques that transcend the limits of conventional Ki Arts.

items.name: Divine Kamehameha
entries: When a creature attacks you, whether the attack hits or misses, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend any number of Ki Points to concentrate your Ki into a single point and unleash a Divine Kamehameha, a powerful Kamehameha wave with even greater energy output and force than a God Kamehameha. The wave travels up to 90 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide.

Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Charged Divine Kamehameha.} When you use Divine Kamehameha, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy immediately.

At the end of the triggering creature's turn, you release the charged Divine Kamehameha without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. When released, the wave travels up to 180 feet in a line that is 15 feet wide, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 7 higher when calculating the attack's damage.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Sphere of Destruction
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend any number of Ki Points to condense your Ki into a sphere of intense purple Destruction energy, radiating overwhelming pressure as destructive energy churns violently within it, before throwing it at a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself.
The Sphere of Destruction detonates at that point in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the sphere takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended.

{@b Charged Sphere of Destruction.} When you use Sphere of Destruction, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy this turn.

At the start of your next turn, you release the charged Sphere of Destruction by throwing it at a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself, without using an Action or Bonus Action. When released, an immense amount of Destruction energy detonates at the chosen point in a 90-foot-radius sphere, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as three times that amount when calculating the attack's damage.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by Sphere of Destruction is completely disintegrated, leaving nothing behind.

(a) an {@item explorer's pack|phb} or (b) a {@item dungeoneer's pack|phb}

classFeature.name: Saiyan Racial
entries: You are a Saiyan, an alien warrior race with tremendous physical potential. When you choose this class, you don't choose a separate race for your character — the traits below replace your race entirely.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 24. Additionally, increase one other ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid (Saiyan).

entries.name: Age
entries: Saiyans stay in their physical prime much longer than humans to maintain their combat strength, maintaining a youthful appearance until about age 80 before aging rapidly. Their natural total lifespan is roughly similar to a human.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Saiyans tend to share common personality traits, even at young ages. Being aggressively militant, they share an innate enjoyment for conflict and fighting. Saiyans are typically very aggressive and hard-headed, with short explosive tempers. Saiyans appear inclined to be arrogant at times, They are typically chaotic natured.

entries.name: Size
entries: Saiyans are Medium or Small, your choice.

entries.name: Saiyan Speed
entries: Saiyans possess tremendous levels of superhuman speed, easily capable of breaking the sound barrier, even with their basic moves. They also have much faster reflexes than an average human
Your base walking speed is 50 feet.

entries.name: Ki Sensing
entries: Saiyans instinctively sense the ki around them. You gain Blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Saiyan Endurance
entries: Saiyans possess enormous amounts of superhuman durability and are a remarkably resilient species who refuse to be physically broken.
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item shield|xphb}, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|xphb} equals 10 plus your Strength and Constitution modifiers.

entries.name: Saiyan Strength
entries: Saiyans naturally possess vast superhuman strength, far greater than that of Earthlings and other alien races and are veritable fighting machines. They are capable of easily lifting ten times their own weight.
You count as two sizes larger than your actual size when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries: All pure-blooded Saiyans are born with a brown-furred, monkey-like tail. The tail is prehensile and can grasp and hold objects weighing up to one-tenth of your carrying capacity, though it can't wield weapons or perform tasks requiring fine manipulation.

As long as you still have your tail, gazing directly upon a full moon triggers an uncontrollable transformation. At the start of your turn, if you can see a full moon and haven't averted your eyes or otherwise avoided its light, you transform into a Great Ape, using the statistics of the {@creature Giant Ape|MM |}.

While transformed, you retain your personality, alignment, and mental ability scores, but you lose the ability to speak, cast spells, or take any action other than Attack, Dash, or Grapple. On each of your turns, you must move toward the creature nearest to you and attack it, friend or foe alike, to the best of your ability.

The transformation ends immediately if your tail is severed, if the moon sets, or if the moon is blocked from your view for the duration of a full turn. When the transformation ends, you revert to your normal form, and your tail (if still attached) is unharmed.

entries.name: Heat Resistance
entries: Your Saiyan biology grants you exceptional resistance to extreme heat. You are unaffected by the effects of extreme heat, and you have Resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and know Common Sign.

classFeature.name: Zenkai
entries: Every 10 minute, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you have at least 1 Hit Point. While you are in combat, this power awakens, and you instead regain twice that amount at the start of each of your turns.

Whenever you regain Hit Points after taking damage from a hostile creature in combat, you gain a number of Zenkai Points equal to the number of Hit Points regained. You can expend Zenkai Points to increase one of your ability scores by 1, at a cost equal to 10 times the new score.

classFeature.name: Ki Points
entries: Saiyans have a natural affinity to control ki energy, allowing them to generate very powerful energy blasts
You have a number of ki points, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Saiyan table. You regain all expended ki points when you finish a short or long rest.
Starting at 1st level, you can use these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing none of these features; you gain them as you reach higher levels in this class.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts I
entries: You can manipulate your Ki to create a variety of energy-based techniques, using your natural Saiyan affinity and martial arts mastery to enhance your combat abilities.

items: {@b Power Full Strike.} At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Ki Point to empower your body with Ki. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit with an melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Flight.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute.

{@b Ki Transfer.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to transfer your Ki to another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the target hits with a melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Ki Charged.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you focus your energy and begin gathering Ki. You regain a number of Ki Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries: You can use Ki Charged a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Telepathy
entries: You know the {@spell Message|XPHB} cantrip. In addition, you can cast the {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot by touching the head of a creature. You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood
entries: At 1st level, you choose a Saiyan Blood, detailed at the end of this class description. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 3rd, 6th, 10th, 14th, 18th and 20th level.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts II
entries: You learn to shape your Ki into powerful blasts and defensive barriers, allowing you to attack from a distance and protect yourself from harm.

items: {@b Ki Wave. } As an {@variantrule Action|xphb}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 + half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, to fire waves of ki in a straight line. The waves travel up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended, multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, a creature takes no damage.

{@b Ki Blast. } As an {@variantrule Bonus Action|xphb}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 + half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, to fire concentrated blasts of Ki. For each Ki Point expended, you fire one blast at a creature within 60 feet of you. Each blast uses your Unarmed Strike attack bonus for its attack roll and deals Force damage equal to your Ki Damage on a hit.

{@b Ki Shield. } As a {@variantrule Reaction|xphb} when you take damage, you can expend 1 Ki Point to surround yourself with a barrier of Ki. The damage you take is reduced by half, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Ki Damage.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken
entries: As a Bonus Action, you can push your body beyond its limits, causing your aura to flare crimson. The transformation lasts for 1 minute. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You can take one additional attack on each of your turns.
• Your Speed is doubled.
• Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} deal additional force damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
When the transformation ends, your body suffers extreme recoil. You become Incapacitated for 1 round and take damage equal to half your current Hit Points.
You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 3rd level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x2
entries: At 5th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×2. While transformed, you can make two additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} deal additional force damage equal to twice your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ki Recovery
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed the ability to rapidly restore its Ki.
At the end of each of your turns, you regain 1 Ki Point. At 10th level, you instead regain 2 Ki Points. At 15th level, you instead regain 3 Ki Points. At 20th level, you instead regain 4 Ki Points.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Instinct
entries: Your Saiyan instincts sharpen your awareness, allowing you to react to danger before combat begins.
You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and add your Proficiency Bonus to those rolls. In addition, you can't be Surprised while you are conscious.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Fortitude
entries: Your Saiyan body can withstand forces that would overwhelm ordinary creatures. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half as much damage on a successful save, you can make a Constitution saving throw instead.
On a successful save, you take no damage from the effect. On a failed save, you take half damage instead.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Spirit
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Saiyan level. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.
You can use this feature twice before a Long Rest starting at level 13 and three times before a Long Rest starting at level 17.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 10th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x10
entries: At 11th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×10. While transformed, you can make three additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} deal additional force damage equal to three time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Resilience
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed extraordinary resilience through countless battles.
Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier + your Strength modifier.
In addition, the Hit Points you regain from your Saiyan Blood are doubled.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 14th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: KI Mastery
entries: You have perfect ki control. The Ki Point cost to transform and maintain a Saiyan Transformation is reduced by half, rounded down.
While you have the Bloodied condition, this feature does not activate.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x20
entries: At 17th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×20. While transformed, you can make four additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|xphb} deal additional force damage equal to four time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@feat Epic Boon|XPHB} or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Limit Break
entries: Each of your ability scores increases by 2.
Your ability scores no longer have a maximum.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 20th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.
